scope: All complete five-root selection reports available at snapshot; no held-out results, no qualification claim

plot_scope.standing: minimum five-root episode duration and minimum final stable streak
plot_scope.travel: five-root mean return, maximum final heading error/distance/speed, minimum final settled streak
plot_scope.interpretation: Standing duration stays near 100 actions against 1000 required. Travel distance and speed improve, but heading and final settled streak still fail. No selection report passes.
